content: sqlx 0.9.0 (crates.io 2026-05-21, MSRV 1.94): defaults any,macros,migrate,json; sqlite feature = sqlite-bundled+deserialize+load-extension+unlock-notify, prefer sqlite-bundled alone; libsqlite3-sys now version range; query*() take impl SqlSafeStr (&'static str or AssertSqlSafe); sqlx.toml opt-in feature; Migrate trait changed; repo moving to transact-rs org.
